concepts.quote: a = b moves the value out of b's box into a's, so b is empty
concepts.why: In Java, a = b copies b's value into a, and b keeps its value; the answer says the value is moved out of b.

concepts.quote: Variables are boxes: ... so b is empty
concepts.why: The answer takes the box metaphor literally, so a variable can be emptied by being read; a Java variable always holds exactly one value.
